# EUFIA Maritime Solutions

## Overview
EUFIA is a maritime shipping and logistics company working across vessel chartering, dry bulk and tanker shipping, freight forwarding, project cargo, cargo inspection, maritime consultancy, global logistics, maritime AI and digital solutions, and vessel spare parts supply coordination.

## Website
- Homepage: https://www.eufiashipping.com/
- About: https://www.eufiashipping.com/about
- Services: https://www.eufiashipping.com/services
- Contact: https://www.eufiashipping.com/contact
- Sitemap: https://www.eufiashipping.com/sitemap.xml

## Core service categories
- Vessel chartering and shipbroking
- Dry bulk shipping
- Tanker chartering
- Freight forwarding
- Project cargo and ODC
- Maritime consultancy and audit support
- Cargo inspection and vessel condition surveys
- Global logistics and multimodal coordination
- Maritime AI and digital solutions
- Vessel spare parts supply and coordination
